body:
The old pipeline reported success after native build failures, ignored compiler warnings and 87 CodeQL findings, and allowed release jobs to succeed while public NuGet publication failed. This PR makes those failures fatal and repairs the defects exposed by the stricter checks.

- Validate C# on Linux/Windows and C++ with GCC, Clang, ASan/UBSan, coverage, formatting, static analysis and real installed-package consumers. Gate every finding in full-repository CodeQL SARIF reports.
- Fix nullable/XML/compiler diagnostics, UniLinks updates, allocation progress, constructor virtual dispatch, transaction error reporting, native query predicates, helper ownership, stale pointers after growth, address exhaustion in all four stores, variadic query restrictions and split data/index capacity accounting. Add focused regressions, equal/unequal split-buffer tests in both languages, and default-off diagnostic callbacks.
- Repair Conan metadata, explicit compiler profiles, heap destruction, dependency build warnings and short-write handling; preserve public headers, CMake targets, NuGet identities and release tags.
- Generate both API references and the Unicode source PDF with pinned tools. Validate generated deployment paths and maintained external links, and handle initial deployment and concurrent updates.
- Require security, dependency, secret and link checks before publishing tested artifacts. Add independent changeset versions, one queued writer, credential preflight, bounded retries, anonymous publication verification and repairable reruns.

Reproduction and validation: the original [main run](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/actions/runs/40767419162), failing-before probes, regression tests and exact commands are preserved in the evidence folder. Locally, **82 C# tests, 46 native tests and 44 pipeline regressions pass**; strict native analysis, both installed-package consumers, benchmark smoke, documentation/PDF generation and the full-history credential scan pass. The native rebuild peaked at 934 MiB RSS with one worker. The [full CI run](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/actions/runs/40842727244) at `5cf40c5a3` is green: both C# platforms, all three native configurations, ASan/UBSan, installed consumers, strict analysis, documentation, links and audit. All three full CodeQL reports have **zero findings** and successful analysis invocations; raw executed-job logs contain **zero compiler/runtime/action warnings**. The documentation artifact contains **538 HTML pages and a 277-page PDF**. All 1,097 artifact files are archived and SHA256-verified. The final evidence-only commit receives the same full CI before handoff.

Automated regressions include the [pipeline failure/skip/publication checks](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/blob/issue-524-b1512fd1c7a8/experiments/test_pipeline_policies.py), [complete SARIF gate tests](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/blob/issue-524-b1512fd1c7a8/experiments/test_sarif_gate.py), [real GCC package-consumer reproduction](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/blob/issue-524-b1512fd1c7a8/experiments/test_package_consumer.py), and language tests for every reproduced storage defect. Run the local commands in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/blob/issue-524-b1512fd1c7a8/CONTRIBUTING.md); failing-before outputs are preserved beside the passing results.

The complete timeline, requirement matrix, root causes, collected logs, thirteen upstream reports and a file-by-file comparison of all **297 C#/C++ template files** are in [the issue evidence folder](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/tree/issue-524-b1512fd1c7a8/dev/log/issues/524/pulls/526). See [ANALYSIS.md](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/blob/issue-524-b1512fd1c7a8/dev/log/issues/524/pulls/526/ANALYSIS.md) and [the full template comparison](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/blob/issue-524-b1512fd1c7a8/dev/log/issues/524/pulls/526/research/TEMPLATE-COMPARISON.md).

The original NuGet response was HTTP 403. A repository owner must provide a valid scoped `NUGET_TOKEN` or configure trusted publishing; main now fails early with explicit instructions when credentials are unusable. PR validation requires no publishing secret. Public release publication has not been performed from this PR.

Fixes #524
title: Fix CI false results, diagnostics and guarded C#/C++ releases
